video.mode.label: Mode
video.sourceHint: Drop the image you want to animate, or pick one from the gallery
video.pickFromGallery: Use the image selected in the gallery
video.pickFromGalleryNone: Select a still image in the gallery first
video.promptPlaceholderText: Describe the video (e.g. waves roll onto a beach at dusk, the camera slowly moves forward)
video.promptPlaceholderImage: Describe how the image should move (e.g. hair and clothes sway in the wind, clouds drift slowly)
video.note: A video takes several minutes on the GPU. Other generations wait while it runs.
video.empty.title: No videos yet
video.empty.description: Choose i2v to animate a reference image.
video.guide.title: How to make a video
video.guide.step1: Download the video models (about 18 GB). This is needed once.
video.guide.step2: Open a video graph with the buttons below. To build your own, add Generate Video from Add node > Video in the editor.
video.guide.step3: Enter the prompt. To animate an image, connect an Image node and choose the image in the left panel.
video.guide.step4: Press Generate to start making the video (it takes a few minutes). The finished video shows up in the gallery (thumbnails with a play mark) and on the Generate tab's Video screen.
video.panelNotice.title: This graph makes a video
video.model.standardHint: More steps: slower, and more careful.
video.model.fastHint: Distilled to 4 steps. A fraction of the time, though fine detail can be rougher than the standard model. Non-commercial license.
video.light.title: Run lighter (when the GPU has little memory)
video.light.fp8: Load the model's weights as fp8
video.light.fp8Hint: Roughly halves the memory the model uses. Fine detail can get slightly rougher.
video.light.tiledHint: Keeps the memory from spiking at the very end. The picture is the same; it is a little slower.
video.light.finishHint: You can also make a small clip and enlarge it afterwards with "Finish…" on the finished clip.
video.model.ownHint: An installed {family} model. The text encoder and the VAE are found by name among the installed models; when one is missing, the file you need is shown.
video.problem.model: The video model you picked is not installed. Pick a model again
